name: Familiar Shadows
summary: As the loyal familiar to your witch, you must brave the dark and ever-shifting forest of the evil wizard to gather the ingredients for a potion that will restore her from the curse that turned her to stone. Each night, the forest transforms, offering new paths to potion ingredients and new ways to get lost. But beware—your ties to this mortal realm weaken, and if dawn breaks before you return, you’ll lose one of your nine lives and all of the ingredients gathered that night. Can you discover potions that will help you brave the depths of the forest? Can you save your witch before your luck runs out?
